recentItems.title: Kirk Franklin, Mariah The Scientist & Flau'jae Had No Business on Wild 'N Out
recentItems.description:
Kirk Franklin, Mariah The Scientist, Flau'jae, DaniLeigh, Gillie Da King, Wallo, Sammie, Bobby V., Luh Tyler, Finesse Mitchell, Big X tha Plug, Conceited, Lola Brooke, and Shuba walked into Wild 'N Out — and none of them came to play nice. Nine full episodes. Nobody was ready for what happened.

Kirk Franklin proves gospel legends have no business being this funny. Flau'jae and Gillie Da King bring Million Dollar Worth of Game energy straight into Wildstyle. Mariah The Scientist closes it all out and makes sure nobody forgets she was here. DaniLeigh and Shuba go all out. Sammie and Bobby V. remind the whole crowd why R&B legends never die. Luh Tyler holds it down fresh out of Tallahassee. Finesse Mitchell, Big X tha Plug, and Conceited make it a full takeover. And Lola Brooke opens the whole thing up the right way.

recentItems.title: Ari Fletcher, Tami Roman & Jim Jones Had No Chill on Wild 'N Out
recentItems.description:
Ari Fletcher, Tami Roman, Jim Jones, ScarLip, OG Parker, and Lil Tjay walk into Wild 'N Out — and nobody was holding back. Five full episodes, zero filters, and some of the most unhinged moments from Seasons 20 and 21.

Ari Fletcher proves she can run with the best of them across Turn Up for What and Talking Spit. Jim Jones and Geena Fontanella bring the heat to Wildstyle. ScarLip and OG Parker refuse to back down. Tami Roman, Jazz Anderson, and SleazyWorld Go turn the stage into a battlefield. And Lil Tjay closes it out in Wildstyle.
